statement: Let s be the non-decreasing sequence obtained by sorting the multiset of values in nums (so s is a permutation of nums with s[0] <= ... <= s[len(nums)-1]). Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. If nums is non-decreasing (for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1]), then r = 0. Otherwise, let l be the least index with 0 <= l < len(nums) and nums[l] != s[l], and let m be the greatest index with 0 <= m < len(nums) and nums[m] != s[m]; then r = m - l + 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 0 <= r <= len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if nums is non-decreasing, i.e., for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r != 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 2 if and only if there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1 such that nums[i] > nums[i+1] and the array obtained from nums by swapping the two entries nums[i] and nums[i+1] is non-decreasing.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r > 0, there exist indices a and b with 0 <= a <= b < len(nums) and b - a + 1 = r such that, if the contiguous subarray nums[a..b] is replaced by its non-decreasing sorted version, the resulting whole array of length len(nums) is non-decreasing.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r > 0, for every pair of indices a and b with 0 <= a <= b < len(nums) and b - a + 1 < r, replacing the contiguous subarray nums[a..b] by its non-decreasing sorted version does not make the whole array non-decreasing.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r and does not fail (in particular, there is no arithmetic overflow, out-of-bounds access, or panic).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = len(nums) if and only if nums[0] > min(nums) and nums[len(nums)-1] < max(nums), where min(nums) and max(nums) are respectively the minimum and maximum values among all entries of nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.

statement: For any two arrays nums and nums' satisfying the preconditions with len(nums) = len(nums'), if for all indices i and j with 0 <= i,j < len(nums) we have nums[i] <= nums[j] if and only if nums'[i] <= nums'[j], then whenever find_unsorted_subarray(nums) returns r and find_unsorted_subarray(nums') returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: nums and nums' each satisfy 1 <= len <= 10^4 and all entries in [-10^5,10^5].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if there exists at least one index i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1 and nums[i] > nums[i+1], let a be the smallest such index and b the largest such index; then r >= b - a + 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5.
